thesis: Naveen Roud argues that the computing industry has been building the same type of digital computer for 80 years, a paradigm chosen in the 1940s to solve scaling issues with analog systems but which now limits efficiency. He contends that biology offers a model of exquisite efficiency and dynamic energy usage that current hardware fails to replicate, and he is building a new system based on first principles to address the global constraint of computing bound by energy.
